title: linux-admin 1.18.17 — vulnerability triage consolidated into security
summary: Top-level skill count is now 69. The former vulnerability-scan-expert is retired after its CVE/scanner triage, false-positive and distro-backport checks, exposure analysis, compensating controls, remediation planning and validation guidance was preserved and expanded in security-expert/chunks/vulnerability-scan.md. sysctl-expert remains separate because it spans runtime kernel tuning, performance and security hardening. The latest published GitHub Release remains v1.17.74.
